transform.paths: logical source URIs; no source identity or review promotion
transform.historical_status: Review and publication strings inside claims describe the original source record only. They do not attest transformed bytes, establish runtime admission, or represent this projection publication status.

visual_source_defects.finding: PWR protection field is blank in original rendered PDF; not extraction loss.

entries.condition: MPU enabled; unaligned load/store hits exactly one device-memory region whose permissions prohibit the access.
entries.response: No workaround. Do not depend on UsageFault taking priority over the access-permission MemManage fault.

entries.condition: LSE analog bypass: LSEBYP=1 and LSEEXT=0.
entries.response: Use digital bypass instead: LSEBYP=1 and LSEEXT=1.

entries.condition: LQFP package, LSE crystal operating, PC13 toggling as input or output.
entries.response: No workaround in table; avoid PC13 toggling while using the crystal. Bypass is unaffected by this entry only; analog bypass has its own erratum.

entries.condition: LSEDRV=00 low drive.
entries.response: Mode forbidden; no workaround. Other drive modes still require electrical qualification.

entries.condition: Family description requires ADC1 and ADC2 simultaneous regular mode DUAL=0x06, with injected stop coinciding with injected trigger.
entries.response: Family alternatives: prevent the listed events coinciding; stop regular before injected conversions; stop injected trigger source first; or use DUAL=0x01/0x02. These are not admitted C542 modes.

entries.condition: SMPTRIG set, regular conversion starts then stops, SMPTRIG cleared, then injected conversion attempted.
entries.response: Disable ADC, clear SMPTRIG, then re-enable ADC before injected conversions.

entries.condition: Both comparators enabled simultaneously.
entries.response: Rev Z: use individually; no workaround for concurrent operation. Rev Y: this specific limitation is marked not applicable; other constraints still apply.

entries.condition: Supply, temperature and process combinations cause insufficient analog entropy and continuous seed errors.
entries.response: Table status N; body requires standard RNG error-management procedure for detection and recovery. No extra application workaround is specified; do not accept seed-error output.

entries.condition: Clearing ENABLE near an interrupt can leave wake signal active and prevent entry to any Stop mode.
entries.response: Disable through assert/deassert of the RCC peripheral reset, rather than clearing ENABLE. Reset impacts the entire owned peripheral configuration.

entries.condition: One-shot, APB slower than kernel, odd programmed REP value (not parity of effective REP+1).
entries.response: Require both ARR and CMP >= KER_CLK/(2*APB_CLK). Use integer-safe comparison; source example REP=3 has four effective repetitions.

entries.condition: Modification of an interrupt bit in LPTIM_DIER.
entries.response: Corresponding ISR flag is cleared by hardware; no workaround. Changing enables must account for pending-event loss.

entries.condition: Core halted in debug; MASKSS nonzero; subsecond alarm met just before halt/printf, even with RTC freeze configured.
entries.response: No workaround. ALRAF/ALRBF may repeatedly reassert; clearing while halted can be ineffective.

entries.condition: Calendar read while BYPSHAD=0; shadow copy can transiently be incorrect.
entries.response: Set BYPSHAD=1; read calendar twice and repeat until consecutive readings agree; follow RM bypass calendar-read protocol.

entries.condition: Write 1 to RTC_SCR, TAMP_SCR or TAMP_CR2.BKERASE while backup-domain writes are protected in PWR.
entries.response: Follow correct write-access sequence before touching these bits. No recovery workaround; system reset is required after lockup. PWR bit name is missing in both extraction and rendered PDF, so exact field binding remains unresolved.

entries.condition: Transmitter minimum data setup time is shorter than one I2C kernel-clock period.
entries.response: Increase kernel frequency or transmitter setup time. At standard minima 250/100/50 ns, require respectively >=4/10/20 MHz. Partial workaround status P is preserved.

entries.condition: Controller-mode spurious BERR and optional error interrupt; transfer itself continues.
entries.response: Clear BERR in software and continue normal handling. Do not infer this action for target mode or unrelated faults; source register spelling needs SDK reconciliation.

entries.condition: Disable autobaud by clearing ABREN after detection while reception continues.
entries.response: Do not clear ABREN. Apply only to exact instances with autobaud capability; inherited register layout is insufficient.

entries.condition: ONEBIT=1 and noise detected on START bit.
entries.response: NE may set despite single-sample mode; no workaround. Bind to exact supported instances before implementation.

entries.condition: Noninteger kernel-frequency/baud ratio between three and four; example 32768/9600.
entries.response: Increase transmitter ratio by raising kernel frequency or lowering baud; alternatively use higher-frequency receiver oversampling if supported. Partial workaround; no proven universal ratio threshold supplied.

entries.condition: Target/slave with RDY output enabled via RDIOM; serial clock exceeds 2*APB for 8..15 bits, 6*APB for 16..23, or 14*APB for 24..32.
entries.response: No workaround for affected configuration. Do not infer safety or applicability for unlisted widths or instances without RDY support.

entries.condition: EFBI enabled and integration-phase end coincides with falling RX edge.
entries.response: Disable edge filtering or rely on retransmission. Source separately says standard-frame reception is unaffected; preserve that qualifier pending exact protocol interpretation.

entries.condition: Dedicated Tx buffer plus Tx FIFO (TFQM=0), with buffer messages having higher internal CAN priority.
entries.response: Choose one documented strategy: only one FIFO transmission pending at once; exclusively use FIFO; or schedule dedicated buffers. Do not treat example buffer numbers as guaranteed exact-device allocation.

entries.condition: OUT-transfer CTR arrives before final USB SRAM accesses finish.
entries.response: Delay before SRAM access: 800 ns Full Speed, 6.4 us Low Speed. Retain both family values; admit only exact-device supported speed modes.
